lead_desc: ZimRx is an open-source, local-first clinical and healthcare suite built for fast, offline practice management, patient consultations, and medical recordkeeping with complete privacy and data sovereignty.
lead_sub: Let's set up your workspace in under a minute.
clinical_lang_hint: Drug names remain in standard Latin/English (INN); patient dosing instructions and lifestyle advice use this language.
help_lang_hint: Workflow guidelines, tutorial popups, and registration help badges will use this language.

token_hint: Because this setup wizard is accessed over the network, please enter the security token found in %s on the server to claim administration.
recovery_desc: Write this down or store it safely. If you forget your password and have no internet, this is your only way back in. It is also saved at userdata/recovery.key.

terms_intro: By installing and using ZimRx, you agree to the following terms:
terms_item_practitioners_desc: Prescribing and clinical decision support (CDS) features are intended exclusively for medical practitioners registered with their respective official licensing authority (e.g., BMDC, GMC, NMC); generating prescriptions without valid medical licensure is not permitted. Technical staff and administrators may deploy and configure this software solely on behalf of authorized clinicians and healthcare facilities.
terms_item_judgment_desc: ZimRx does not provide autonomous medical diagnoses or treatment decisions. All clinical decision support (CDS) features (including drug-drug interaction alerts, contraindication flags, and pediatric dose calculators) are informational reference aids only. Final diagnostic, therapeutic, and prescribing responsibility rests solely with the attending clinician.
terms_item_safety_title: No Inferred Safety or Catalog Completeness:
terms_item_safety_desc: Drug databases and interaction rules are finite and depend on local catalog updates. The absence of a warning never implies clinical safety; you must independently verify all dosages, indications, and pharmacological parameters.
terms_item_custody_desc: Because ZimRx operates on a local-first architecture, all patient records reside on your local device or self-managed environment. You are solely responsible for device security, patient data privacy compliance, and maintaining regular backups.
terms_item_warranty_desc: Licensed under the GNU AGPL-3.0 and provided "AS IS" without warranty of any kind. The authors and contributors assume no liability for clinical outcomes, prescribing errors, or data loss.
